## Ontario Landlord-Tenant Deposit Checklist


A practical, neutral checklist for asking for an itemized explanation and seeking the remaining deposit balance after move-out. This is general information only, not a legal verdict.

## Typical Steps and Documents to Gather

| Step | What to do | Documents / proof to keep |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Confirm the deposit type and amount | Lease, receipt, bank transfer record, move-in paperwork |
| 2 | Write down the timeline | Move-out date: 2026-02-28; date deposit was withheld; any messages about deductions |
| 3 | Request an itemized explanation in writing | Email or letter, with a clear deadline for reply |
| 4 | Collect condition evidence | Move-in/move-out photos, videos, inspection notes, witness names |
| 5 | Gather payment records | Rent receipts, deposit payment proof, refund attempts, bank statements |
| 6 | Keep all communications | Texts, emails, letters, portal messages, voicemails summarized in notes |
| 7 | Review the landlord’s reason for keeping funds | Cleaning, repairs, unpaid rent, damage claims, or other deductions |
| 8 | Decide next step if the balance is not returned | Consider tenant-board or small-claims options based on the type of deposit and dispute facts |

## What to Include in Your File

- Lease agreement and any addenda
- Proof of the deposit paid
- Move-in and move-out inspection reports, if any
- Photos/videos from move-in and move-out
- All messages about deductions or return of funds
- Forwarding address or contact details you gave the landlord
- A written record of dates, amounts, and names
- Any invoices, estimates, or receipts the landlord provided
- Proof of final rent payment and utility settlement, if relevant

## Polite Written Request Template

Subject: Request for itemized explanation and return of deposit balance

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I moved out of the rental unit on 2026-02-28. I understand that part of my deposit was retained.

Please provide a written, itemized explanation of the amount withheld, including the specific reason for each deduction and any supporting invoices, receipts, or estimates. If any balance remains after those deductions, please return the remaining amount to me.

For convenience, you may send the response to:
[Your mailing address]
[Your email address]

Please reply by [date, usually 7–14 days from sending].

Thank you for your time and attention.

Sincerely,
[Your full name]
[Phone number]
[Email address]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Draft Letter] https://www.ontario.ca/page/renting-ontario-your-rights-and-responsibilities
Action: [Button: Tenant Board Info] https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/
Action: [Button: Small Claims] https://www.ontario.ca/page/small-claims-court

## Sources

- Ontario government, renting rights and responsibilities: https://www.ontario.ca/page/renting-ontario-your-rights-and-responsibilities
- Tribunals Ontario, Landlord and Tenant Board: https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/
- Ontario Small Claims Court overview: https://www.ontario.ca/page/small-claims-court
